startupRules: Use existing production WorkoutSessionPolicy.shouldAutoStart path at RootView:2233–2240; HANGTEN_REVIEW_AUTOSTART must be absent, not1. Keep HANGTEN_REVIEW_STEP absent and do not Skip/seek. Preserve failed first root run with possible double-toggle as invalid historical evidence.

Why: DEBUG explicit auto-start at2227–2230 and production shouldAutoStart below are distinct calls. Audio readiness can defer activeStartUptime, so they cannot be assumed mutually exclusive merely from activeStart guard. This proposal changes neither path; it avoids the explicit DEBUG trigger.

Keep real research.max-hangs7s work/180s rest, same audio preference/access state/board and diagnostic environment. Root direct and rootNav start immediately after gate launch; normal route may warm audio/ODR through prior Train/navigation time. Do not equalize startup with new delays or pretend warm state matches; record appearance, preparation/countdown and real activeStart timing.

Each arm is a fresh app process on the same installed binary; preserve app storage/settings consistently and do not clear unrelated state. Verify actual exact selected plan/board before interpreting captures.
boundedOrderIfNormalFinalFails: Apply only after root gate; one build of optional stack patch. Run fresh direct-root control with stackflag absent and explicit AUTOSTART absent through initial Hang/early+late natural Rest/next Hang.
Run rootNav with only stackflag1 changed, same natural sequence/capture strategy. Require actual UIKit/frame+scene census and same package/code payload. No Train/Tab history occurs in either arm.

If control passes/rootNav fails, one confirmation pair may establish reproducibility; conclusion is stack/toolbars/safe-area/lifecycle boundary sufficient in this setup, not a specific NavigationStack defect.

If both pass, do not alter production navigation. Remaining normal-only differences include Tab/Train predecessor host/history, destination push transition and warm startup. Parent decides a single next boundary; no automatic growing matrix.
If direct control now fails, prior direct2 success may be intermittent or new common structure/environment matters; stop causal comparison and retain both raw outcomes.
ifNormalUnexpectedlyPasses: Do not launch rootNav automatically. Preserve early Rest stale frames as latency failure if expected settled gate was exceeded, distinguish eventual correction from all-frame success, and compare capture timestamps against current update/material evidence. If overall normal sequence actually satisfies the agreed gate, repeat one matched normal natural cycle to test reproducibility before expanding architecture experiments.
requiredEvidence: Whole expected red/blue/red board frames; CPUmode/RGBA brackets alone do not pass.
Per-phase actual UIKit board frame and root/camera/view IDs; initial viewport, safe-area geometry and toolbar visibility. No claim260/210/360 size is inherently wrong.
Root branch flag, absence of explicit AUTOSTART/STEP/standalone flags, exact source/binary hashes, same cue/hand/material configuration.
Initial root/access gate/workout appear count and disappear events; navigation destination is not pushed in rootNav.
Audio preparation/countdown readiness and background/foreground events; no interaction used to repair stale frames.
limits: NavigationStack introduces native containment, toolbar, safe-area geometry and startup lifecycle as a bundle. This experiment cannot assign causality among them.
RootNav root has no pushed-back navigation item, unlike normal deep-link destination; a pass does not exclude push/history-dependent behavior.
Actual toolbar actions/End dismissal not part of probe and should not be exercised.
Patch only passes git apply --check; no compile or runtime verification performed.
